create table matchmaking.team_feature (
  team_id uuid primary key references public.teams(id) on delete cascade,
  skills text[] not null, foundations text[] not null,
  domains double precision[] not null check (cardinality(domains)=7),
  role_keys text[] not null, role_counts integer[] not null,
  college_key text, ticket uuid not null,
  version integer not null default 1, refreshed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  foundation_mask bit(16) not null
)

begin
  -- Serialize feature rebuilds for this team. The subsequent reads use the
  -- current READ COMMITTED snapshot after a concurrent writer releases its lock.
  select x.id,x.skills,x.roles_needed,x.college,x.is_recruiting,x.owner_id into t
  from public.teams x where x.id=v_id for no key update

counts := array(select (
    select count(distinct tm.user_id)::integer
    from public.team_members tm
    join matchmaking.role_alias a on a.alias=matchmaking.norm(tm.project_role)
    join matchmaking.role_definition r on r.key=a.role_key
    where tm.team_id=v_id and i=any(r.required_domains)
  ) from generate_series(1,7) i order by i)

create trigger matchmaking_team_changed after insert or update of
  skills,roles_needed,college,is_recruiting,owner_id
on public.teams for each row execute function matchmaking.team_changed()

create trigger matchmaking_member_changed after insert or delete or update of team_id,user_id,project_role
on public.team_members for each row execute function matchmaking.member_changed()

-- Existing UNIQUE(blocker_id,blocked_id) serves the forward direction.
create index if not exists idx_team_members_team_user on public.team_members(team_id,user_id)
create index if not exists idx_team_members_user_team on public.team_members(user_id,team_id)
pivot:=md5(p_user_id::text||':'||(now() at time zone 'UTC')::date::text||':teams:v1')::uuid

return query
  with pool as materialized (select q.id from matchmaking.team_pool(buckets,pivot) q),
  eligible as materialized (
    select t.id,t.max_members,roster.n as member_count,
           f.domains,f.foundation_mask,f.role_keys,f.role_counts,
           case when me.college_key is null or f.college_key is null then null
                else me.college_key=f.college_key end as same
    from pool q join public.teams t on t.id=q.id
    join public.profiles owner on owner.id=t.owner_id
    join matchmaking.team_feature f on f.team_id=t.id and f.version=1
    cross join lateral (
      -- Owner counts even if a legacy roster omitted their membership row.
      select count(*)::integer as n from (
        select tm.user_id from public.team_members tm where tm.team_id=t.id
        union select t.owner_id
      ) people
    ) roster
    where t.is_recruiting is true and t.max_members>0 and roster.n<t.max_members
      and t.owner_id<>p_user_id and not (t.owner_id=any(blocked))
      and owner.onboarding_completed is true and not coalesce(owner.is_banned,false)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.team_members tm where tm.team_id=t.id
                     and (tm.user_id=p_user_id or tm.user_id=any(blocked)))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.team_join_requests jr where jr.team_id=t.id
                     and jr.user_id=p_user_id and jr.status='pending')
      and not exists(select 1 from public.team_invites ti where ti.team_id=t.id
                     and ti.invited_user_id=p_user_id and ti.status='pending')
  ), raw as materialized (
    select e.id,e.member_count,e.same,best.label,
      case when (select sum(x) from unnest(me.domains) x)>0 then best.value else null end as role_fit,
      matchmaking.novelty(me.domains,e.domains) as novelty,
      matchmaking.baseline_bits(me.foundation_mask,e.foundation_mask) as base,
      -- Prefer teams with some existing collaborators, not teams with most vacancies.
      least(1.0,e.member_count::double precision/greatest(e.max_members-1,1)) as size_fit,
      case when e.same then 1.0 else 0.5 end as college_fit,
      e.same is not null as college_known
    from eligible e
    left join lateral (
      select r.label,
        (select min(me.domains[d])*(0.85+0.15/(1+avg(e.role_counts[d])))
         from unnest(r.required_domains) d) as value
      from matchmaking.role_definition r where r.key=any(e.role_keys)
      order by value desc,r.key limit 1
    ) best on true
  ), ranked as materialized (
    select r.id,r.member_count,r.same,
      case when r.role_fit>0 then r.label end as matched_role,
      r.role_fit,r.novelty,r.base,
      0.70*coalesce(r.novelty,0.5)+0.30*coalesce(r.base,0.5) as skill_fit,
      case when prefer then 0.75*r.size_fit+0.25*r.college_fit else r.size_fit end as context_fit,
      0.60*coalesce(r.role_fit,0.5)
       +0.30*(0.70*coalesce(r.novelty,0.5)+0.30*coalesce(r.base,0.5))
       +0.10*(case when prefer then 0.75*r.size_fit+0.25*r.college_fit else r.size_fit end) as fit,
      0.60*(r.role_fit is not null)::integer
       +0.21*(r.novelty is not null)::integer+0.09*(r.base is not null)::integer
       +0.10*(case when prefer then 0.75+0.25*r.college_known::integer else 1.0 end) as evidence
    from raw r order by fit desc,evidence desc,r.id limit lim
  )
  select t.id,t.name,t.description,t.college,t.skills,t.roles_needed,t.hackathon_id,t.hackathon_name,
    t.max_members,r.member_count,round((r.fit*100)::numeric)::integer,coalesce(r.same,false),r.matched_role,
    r.evidence::double precision,jsonb_build_object('role_gap',r.role_fit,'skill_fit',r.skill_fit,
      'novelty',r.novelty,'foundation',r.base,'context',r.context_fit),
    array_remove(array[
      case when r.matched_role is not null then 'Evidence for vacancy: '||r.matched_role end,
      case when r.novelty>=0.7 then 'Adds domain coverage' end,
      case when r.same then 'Same verified college mapping' end,
      case when r.role_fit is null then 'Discovery suggestion: vacancy or role evidence is incomplete' end
    ],null),'mm-v1'::text
  from ranked r join public.teams t on t.id=r.id
  order by r.fit desc,r.evidence desc,r.id

SELECT count(*) INTO v_size FROM (

-- Compatibility contract: max_participants is enforced as a limit on
  -- confirmed REGISTRATION ROWS, not teams or distinct human participants.
  -- Separate SQL command after acquiring the event lock: fresh READ COMMITTED

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_confirmed_rows FROM public.hackathon_registrations r
    WHERE r.hackathon_id = NEW.hackathon_id AND r.status = 'confirmed'

WITH
c AS (
  SELECT 'GL Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura'::text AS m_name,
         'gl-bajaj-mathura'::text AS m_key,
         'GL Bajaj Institute of Technology & Management, Greater Noida'::text AS n_name,
         'gl-bajaj-greater-noida'::text AS n_key,
         ARRAY['gl bajaj group of institutions mathura','gl bajaj group of institution mathura','gl bajaj mathura'] AS m_keys,
         ARRAY['gl bajaj institute of technology and management greater noida'] AS n_keys
),
-- Inlined matchmaking.college_key(): alias = lower(btrim(collapsed whitespace)).
prof AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.college, al.college_key AS resolved, f.college_key AS feature_key, f.eligible, k.match_key
  FROM public.profiles p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT coalesce(string_agg(w.word, ' ' ORDER BY w.pos), '') AS match_key
    FROM (
      SELECT min(i.ord) AS pos,
             CASE WHEN i.single THEN string_agg(i.tok, '' ORDER BY i.ord) ELSE min(i.tok) END AS word
      FROM (
        SELECT t.tok, t.ord, t.single, t.ord - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.single ORDER BY t.ord) AS grp
        FROM (
          SELECT s.tok, s.ord, s.tok ~ '^[a-z]$' AS single
          FROM regexp_split_to_table(
            btrim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(p.college, '')), '&', ' and '), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')), ' '
          ) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(tok, ord)
          WHERE s.tok <> ''
        ) t
      ) i
      GROUP BY i.single, CASE WHEN i.single THEN i.grp ELSE i.ord END
    ) w
  ) k
  LEFT JOIN matchmaking.college_alias al ON al.alias = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(p.college, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')))
  LEFT JOIN matchmaking.builder_feature f ON f.user_id = p.id
  WHERE p.college ILIKE '%bajaj%'
),
cat AS (
  SELECT prof.*,
    CASE
      WHEN college = c.m_name THEN 'canonical_mathura'
      WHEN college = c.n_name THEN 'canonical_greater_noida'
      WHEN match_key = ANY (c.m_keys) THEN 'legacy_mathura'
      WHEN match_key = ANY (c.n_keys) THEN 'legacy_greater_noida'
      WHEN match_key ~ '(^| )(gl bajaj|glbajaj)( |$)' THEN 'ambiguous'
      ELSE 'unrelated'
    END AS category
  FROM prof, c
),
n AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'legacy_mathura') AS legacy,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'canonical_mathura') AS canonical_m,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'canonical_greater_noida') AS canonical_n,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE category IN ('ambiguous', 'unrelated') AND (resolved IN (c.m_key, c.n_key) OR feature_key IN (c.m_key, c.n_key))) AS ambiguous_keyed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'canonical_mathura' AND (resolved IS DISTINCT FROM c.m_key OR feature_key IS DISTINCT FROM c.m_key)) AS m_wrong,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'canonical_greater_noida' AND (resolved IS DISTINCT FROM c.n_key OR feature_key IS DISTINCT FROM c.n_key)) AS n_wrong,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved IN (c.m_key, c.n_key) AND feature_key IS DISTINCT FROM resolved) AS stale
  FROM cat CROSS JOIN c
),
bf AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM matchmaking.gl_bajaj_college_backfill) AS rows,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM matchmaking.gl_bajaj_college_backfill b JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = b.profile_id
       WHERE p.college IS DISTINCT FROM b.new_college) AS edited_since,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM matchmaking.gl_bajaj_college_backfill b
       JOIN matchmaking.college_alias al ON al.alias = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(b.previous_college, '\s+', ' ', 'g')))
       CROSS JOIN c WHERE al.college_key = c.m_key) AS previous_aliased
),
al AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.college_key = c.m_key) AS m_aliases,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.college_key = c.n_key) AS n_aliases,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.college_key = c.m_key AND (x.alias ~ 'noida' OR x.alias !~ 'mathura')) AS m_cross,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.college_key = c.n_key AND (x.alias ~ 'mathura' OR x.alias !~ 'noida')) AS n_cross,
    bool_or(x.alias = lower(c.m_name) AND x.college_key = c.m_key) AS m_canonical,
    bool_or(x.alias = lower(c.n_name) AND x.college_key = c.n_key) AS n_canonical,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.college_key NOT IN (c.m_key, c.n_key)) AS other_n,
    coalesce(md5(string_agg(x.alias || '=' || x.college_key, E'\n' ORDER BY x.alias)
      FILTER (WHERE x.college_key NOT IN (c.m_key, c.n_key))), '') AS other_fp
  FROM matchmaking.college_alias x CROSS JOIN c
),
feed AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS missing
  FROM matchmaking.builder_feature f, c
  WHERE f.college_key IN (c.m_key, c.n_key) AND f.eligible
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matchmaking.builder_feed b WHERE b.user_id = f.user_id AND b.bucket = 'college:' || f.college_key)
),
orphan AS (
  -- Cached GL Bajaj keys whose stored college no longer resolves to that key.
  SELECT count(*) AS n
  FROM matchmaking.builder_feature f
  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = f.user_id
  CROSS JOIN c
  LEFT JOIN matchmaking.college_alias al ON al.alias = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(p.college, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')))
  WHERE f.college_key IN (c.m_key, c.n_key) AND al.college_key IS DISTINCT FROM f.college_key
),
tm AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS stale
  FROM public.teams t
  CROSS JOIN c
  JOIN matchmaking.college_alias al ON al.alias = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(t.college, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')))
  LEFT JOIN matchmaking.team_feature f ON f.team_id = t.id
  WHERE al.college_key IN (c.m_key, c.n_key) AND f.college_key IS DISTINCT FROM al.college_key
)

RETURNS TABLE (

  other_user_id uuid,
  last_message text,
  last_message_at timestamptz,
  unread_count bigint
)

STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$

  v_my_id uuid := (SELECT auth.uid())

  WITH my_dms AS (
    SELECT
      cp.conversation_id,
      cp.cleared_at,
      other_cp.user_id AS other_user_id
    FROM public.conversation_participants cp
    JOIN public.conversations c ON c.id = cp.conversation_id AND c.type = 'dm'
    JOIN public.conversation_participants other_cp 
      ON other_cp.conversation_id = cp.conversation_id 
     AND other_cp.user_id <> v_my_id
    WHERE cp.user_id = v_my_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.blocked_users b
        WHERE (b.blocker_id = v_my_id AND b.blocked_id = other_cp.user_id)

      )
  ),
  ranked_messages AS (
    SELECT
      m.conversation_id,
      m.content,
      m.created_at,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY m.conversation_id 
        ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM public.messages m
    JOIN my_dms d ON d.conversation_id = m.conversation_id

      count(*) AS unread_cnt

    JOIN my_dms d ON d.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
    WHERE m.sender_id <> v_my_id
      AND m.is_read = false
      AND (d.cleared_at IS NULL OR m.created_at > d.cleared_at)
    GROUP BY m.conversation_id
  )

    d.conversation_id,
    d.other_user_id,
    rm.content AS last_message,
    rm.created_at AS last_message_at,

    join public.profiles owner on owner.id=t.owner_id

      and not exists(select 1 from public.team_invites ti where ti.team_id=t.id
                     and ti.invited_user_id=p_user_id and ti.status='pending')
  ), raw as materialized (
    select e.id,e.member_count,e.same,best.label,
      case when (select sum(x) from unnest(me.domains) x)>0 then best.value else null end as role_fit,
      matchmaking.novelty(me.domains,e.domains) as novelty,
      matchmaking.baseline_bits(me.foundation_mask,e.foundation_mask) as base,
      -- Prefer teams with some existing collaborators, not teams with most vacancies.
      least(1.0,e.member_count::double precision/greatest(e.max_members-1,1)) as size_fit,
      case when e.same then 1.0 else 0.5 end as college_fit,
      e.same is not null as college_known
    from eligible e
    left join lateral (
      select r.label,
        (select min(me.domains[d])*(0.85+0.15/(1+avg(e.role_counts[d])))
         from unnest(r.required_domains) d) as value
      from matchmaking.role_definition r where r.key=any(e.role_keys)
      order by value desc,r.key limit 1
    ) best on true
  ), ranked as materialized (
    select r.id,r.member_count,r.same,
      case when r.role_fit>0 then r.label end as matched_role,
      r.role_fit,r.novelty,r.base,
      0.70*coalesce(r.novelty,0.5)+0.30*coalesce(r.base,0.5) as skill_fit,
      case when prefer then 0.75*r.size_fit+0.25*r.college_fit else r.size_fit end as context_fit,
      0.60*coalesce(r.role_fit,0.5)

       +0.10*(case when prefer then 0.75+0.25*r.college_known::integer else 1.0 end) as evidence
    from raw r order by fit desc,evidence desc,r.id limit lim
  )

    t.max_members,r.member_count,round((r.fit*100)::numeric)::integer,coalesce(r.same,false),r.matched_role,
    r.evidence::double precision,jsonb_build_object('role_gap',r.role_fit,'skill_fit',r.skill_fit,
